title: ilex aggregata
intro: Ilex aggregata, commonly known as American Holly, is a species of flowering plant in the family Aquifoliaceae. The health benefits of American Holly include its potential to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which can contribute to its overall anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of American Holly are thought to be due to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
